source: Federal Reserve Economic Data (FRED), Federal Reserve Bank of St. Louis — API series/observations
rules: Values exactly as returned by FRED (frequency=m). Missing values are null, never filled.

ahe.label: Average hourly earnings, all private employees (SA)

mortgage30.label: 30-year fixed mortgage rate, Freddie Mac PMMS (monthly average of weekly)

sentiment.label: University of Michigan consumer sentiment
sentiment.note: Copyrighted third-party series (D-051); research use only, not for publication.

sp500.label: S&P 500 index (month-end close)
sp500.note: S&P Dow Jones Indices via FRED; FRED holds roughly ten years only.
